messages:
alex.k: Quick sync — we need to coordinate a rebuild+signing run for our container base images (ubuntu:22.04 alpine:3.18) to pick up the OpenSSL/glibc fixes that landed this week. Any blockers for doing a full canary next Wednesday?

maria.s: +1 we also need to produce signed image snapshots and attestation metadata. Prefer cosign + KMS-backed keys.

kevin-r: Question: do we use AWS KMS for cosign or Vault transit? We need to lock down RBAC for the key usage in CI. Current infra role gives buildkite access to ECR push, but not to decrypt keys.

jen_p: From security side: prefer using customer-managed key in KMS with strict IAM (only pipeline role can Sign, no decrypt). Also require 1y retention for build audit logs and attestation storage in S3 with server-side encryption + access logs.

samw: CI changes are minor but we need to rotate ephemeral creds and add a build-step that calls cosign. Proposed job snippet:```bash
# sign image
COSIGN_KEYREF=awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEYREF $IMAGE_URI
```
We will gate push until signature present.

infra-bot: CI matrix for rebuild created: job=baseimage-rebuild, targets=[ubuntu22.04,alpine318], arch=[amd64,arm64], regions=[us-west-2,eu-west-1]. Expected runtime ~40m per build.

maria.s: Also: generate SLSA attestation and store predicate in S3 prefix s3://redwood-artifacts/attestations/baseimage/2026-11-03/<digest>.json. Audit requirement: tie who triggered the run (principle) and pipeline run id.

alex.k: Good. Two operational asks: 1) canary cadence (staging -> prod-canary -> prod) 2) how do we handle multi-arch digest pinning so consumers don't break?

kevin-r: Canary cadence idea: run canary on staging (eu-west-1) with 10% traffic, smoke tests + evals (latency/cold-start/kv-cache sanity). If green after 2 hours, promote to prod-canary (one region), monitor 24h, then full rollout. We have automation in routing service to split by tag.

jen_p: For priority: classify these fixes as P1 if CVE CVSS >= 7.0 or exploit seen in wild. The OpenSSL CVE list I reviewed includes CVE-2026-1423 (7.8) and a glibc fix CVE-2026-2101 (8.2) — treat both as high urgency.

samw: On multi-arch pinning: publish a manifest list with immutable digests and then update our official baseimage:prod tag only after successful canary. Consumers should pin to digest if they want absolute immutability; we can publish a mapping file in the artifacts bucket for convenience.

maria.s: We need to sign both the image and the SBOM/attestation. cosign can sign multiple artifacts. Example:```bash
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEYREF $IMAGE_URI
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEYREF --type attestation --payload sbom.json $IMAGE_URI
```
Make sure KMS key policy forbids key usage from developer laptops. Only CI role ARN allowed.

kevin-r: RBAC changes: create a role `ci/baseimage-signer` with AssumeRole from buildkite and a condition on source IP ranges for the runners. Attach IAM policy with kms:Sign on that specific key and s3:PutObject on the attestation prefix.

alex.k: Testing matrix: unit smoke, end-to-end app bootstrap (3 requests), regression test for musl vs glibc differences on alpine (some libraries break when switching). Also run our fuzz harness for crypto operations.

jen_p: Add requirement: pre-rebuild vulnerability scan of final image with our scanner (trivy + internal SBOM compare). If new critical/high CVEs appear from transitive deps during rebuild, abort and triage.

samw: CI will upload SBOM to bucket and create an issue in #security automatically if trivy finds >=1 HIGH. We need a small script to convert trivy JSON to our triage template.

maria.s: Audit logging: enable S3 access logging + CloudTrail events for the KMS key. Retention 1 year, export to archive daily. Also require cosine signatures be recorded in the CI run metadata (pipeline id, commit sha).

kevin-r: Ops question: do we keep old signed images around? I recommend retaining 30 days for quick rollback then move to cold storage (if legal) for 1 year. Need to confirm storage budget.

alex.k: Action items: A1: kevin create IAM role + KMS policy (due Mon) A2: samw add cosign steps + gating (due Tue) A3: maria produce attestation storage layout + retention policy (due Mon) A4: jen publish triage checklist + CVSS threshold (due Mon) A5: infra create canary schedule for Wed 23:00 UTC (due Tue)

jen_p: I'll approve the plan as long as RBAC and audit logs are in place before the canary.

maria.s: I'll own attestation and SBOM signing.

samw: I'll send the PR for CI changes this afternoon, pinging reviewers.

kevin-r: I'll draft the IAM/KMS JSON and post to the thread for review.

alex.k: Thanks all. I'll publish the rollout note and add the monitoring dashboard links. Will follow up with final go/no-go 2 hours before the scheduled canary. :thumbsup:
